title: The Forgotten Kingdom
summary: Ha-Jun explores the ancient ruins of Necrothea, uncovering murals of the First Sovereign's golden age and discovering that his brother Tae-Jun was captured by the Three Demon Lords.

panels.shot: grand boulevard of necrothea wide shot
panels.action: A 100-meter-wide grand ceremonial avenue paved in polished black volcanic glass, flanked by towering statues.

panels.shot: abandoned palatial buildings with crystalline spires
panels.action: Crumbling palaces of dark obsidian and amethyst crystal, silent monuments to a fallen golden empire.

panels.shot: ha-jun walking down the center of the avenue
panels.action: Ha-Jun walks down the road, his boots clicking rhythmically on the mirror-smooth black glass.

panels.shot: kuro fluttering from statue to statue
panels.action: Kuro glides ahead, his eyes filled with nostalgic sorrow: 'Yahan 10 million demons rehte the ek waqt par.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: First Sovereign ke era mein yeh kingdom celestial realms se bhi zyada glorious tha.

panels.shot: ha-jun pausing before a massive triumphal archway
panels.action: A 150-foot archway carved with intricate narrative bas-relief murals depicting the ancient wars.

panels.shot: mural depicting the seven demon kings rebelling
panels.action: The stone mural shows seven horned kings turning their blades against a single crowned sovereign figure.

dialogue.text: Seven Demon Kings ne First Sovereign ke vishwaas ko toda... Aur realm ko do hisso mein baant diya.

panels.shot: mural showing the sovereign sealing his ten relics
panels.action: The First Sovereign carving out his own heart and marrow, sealing his supreme authority into ten relics.

panels.shot: ha-jun touching the mural with reverence
panels.action: Ha-Jun's fingertips trace the relief of the sovereign's face; a psychic jolt ripples into his mind.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Woh betrayed the... Apne hi senapatiyo ke haatho.

panels.shot: glowing red footsteps continuing past the arch
panels.action: Tae-Jun's crimson mana footprints lead off the main boulevard toward an underground amphitheater.

panels.shot: signs of recent violent struggle on the pavement
panels.action: Deep slash marks in the glass street, black demon blood splattered across a broken obelisk.

panels.shot: ha-jun kneeling to inspect black blood
panels.action: Ha-Jun dips a finger in the fresh, still-smoking demon blood: 'Yeh blood sirf do ghante purana hai.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Bhai yahan kisi se lade the. Aur unka dushman kamzor nahi tha.

panels.shot: kuro inspecting the slash marks
panels.action: Kuro's eyes widen: 'Shadow scythe marks... Valac ke Shadow Assassins!'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Demon Lord Valac ne apne elite hunters ko bheja tha Tae-Jun ko capture karne ke liye!

panels.shot: ha-jun finding a torn piece of white fabric
panels.action: Caught on a jagged stone: a torn scrap of a white hospital patient gown, stained with dried blood.

panels.shot: ha-jun clutching the fabric to his chest
panels.action: Ha-Jun clutches the cloth tightly, his eyes blazing with fury: 'Unhone bhai ko capture kar liya hai...'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Main bohot kareeb tha... Sirf do ghante late!

panels.shot: kuro flying onto ha-jun forearm
panels.action: Kuro reassures him firmly: 'Woh use maarenge nahi, Ha-Jun! Unhe uske blood se Relics ko unseal karna hai!'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Tae-Jun safe hai jab tak unke paas bache hue relics nahi hain!

panels.shot: ha-jun looking toward the amphitheater entrance
panels.action: Ha-Jun looks toward the subterranean archway: 'Aur agla Relic yahan niche hai?'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: The Fang of Abyss... Yahi hai na?

panels.shot: kuro nodding with sharp determination
panels.action: Kuro confirms: 'Amphitheater ke Vault of Severance mein. The Fang of Abyss.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Agar humne woh dagger claim kar liya, toh hum kisi bhi dimensional barrier ko cheer sakte hain!

panels.shot: ha-jun standing to full height
panels.action: Ha-Jun pockets his brother's cloth scrap, his bone gauntlet glowing ready for war.

panels.shot: descending massive stone staircase into amphitheater
panels.action: Ha-Jun descends a sweeping circular staircase that wraps around a colossal sunken colosseum.

panels.shot: sunken colosseum arena reveal
panels.action: A 200-meter circular gladiatorial arena paved in white petrified bones, surrounded by shattered spectator thrones.

panels.shot: pedestal in arena center holding black crystal prism
panels.action: In the dead center of the arena, an obsidian obelisk suspends a floating 3-foot rhomboid crystal prism.

panels.shot: inside prism: the fang of abyss
panels.action: Sealed inside the crystal: an eight-inch jagged curved dagger forged from solid midnight void matter.

dialogue.text:
[TARGET LOCATED: THE FANG OF ABYSS (RARE RELIC)]
Authority: Spatial Severance & Void Piercing
Guardian Status: ACTIVE / EN ROUTE

panels.shot: ha-jun stepping onto arena floor
panels.action: The moment Ha-Jun's boot touches the bone tiles, a low subsonic vibration rattles the colosseum pillars.

panels.shot: kuro looking up at the dark amphitheater dome
panels.action: Kuro's feathers bristle: 'Upar dekho! The Apex Guardian!'

panels.shot: colossal 40-foot abyssal void dragon dropping
panels.action: Coiled like a bat among the high gothic vaults, a 40-foot Void Dragon unfurls its wings and drops.

panels.shot: dragon slamming onto arena floor
panels.action: The colossal beast lands with catastrophic weight, fracturing bones and sending shockwaves across the colosseum.

panels.shot: void dragon design close-up
panels.action: Sleek obsidian scales, four glowing indigo eyes, an elongated serpentine neck, and wings made of starry void space.

panels.shot: dragon throat glowing with blinding violet antimatter
panels.action: The dragon's neck swells with blinding violet energy as it charges a full-power Spatial Breath beam.

panels.shot: ha-jun manifesting dual bloodfire katanas
panels.action: Ha-Jun crosses his twin flaming blades before him, irises blazing with fearless resolve.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Pehle ek guardian centurion... Ab ek dragon. Bring it on!

panels.shot: spatial breath beam erupting from dragon maw
panels.action: A 10-meter-wide beam of pure space-deleting violet void fire blasts straight at Ha-Jun.
